template: ts_decay_linear(trade_when(greater(group_zscore(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), industry), 1.5), signed_power(winsorize(vec_avg({likelihood_score}) - ts_mean(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 30), std=4), 1.5) * ((vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice})) / ts_mean(vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice}), 30)), 0), 5)
idea: 融合极端置信条件（zscore>1.5）、行业中性化（group_zscore）、非线性尾部放大（signed_power）与衰减平滑（ts_decay_linear），构建“高置信+行业极端偏离+低换手”的复合信号。
